annotations.title: Make a link that opens a routine in the app

description: Checks a routine written in the form how_to_write_a_routine describes and returns a link. Opened on an iPhone with Routine Run, it shows the routine on the app's review screen, where the person saves it or not. Nothing is kept here. Give the person the link and the JSON too, in case the link is opened somewhere else.

routine.description: The routine: one JSON object in the form, with "routineRun": 2, a name and its steps. JSON text is read too.

routineRun.description: The form it is written in: 2.

title.description: What to do, as an instruction.

name: routine_link

json.description: The routine, for the person to copy when there is no link or it is opened somewhere else.

link.description: Opens the routine on the app's review screen; null when the routine is too long for a link.
